notes.title: The New & Improved: Reaper
notes.content:
http://www.rocketeergames.com/media/Promo/ReaperPPromo.jpg

The Reapers have received some tender loving care this week in Red Crucible Firestorm. Not only has the Reaper P received an updated skin, both Reapers have received more competitive stat buffs. Here are the list of changes and improvements:

• Reaper P accuracy has been increased to match the Reaper Gs.
• Reaper (and Reaper P) reload time decreased by half a second
• Reaper (and Reaper P) fire rate slightly increased

You can now find the Reaper and the Reaper Warchest available now in the Store.

notes.title: What's New in Red Crucible: Firestorm
notes.content:
Hey Red Crucible Fans!

Since the release on Steam, we've made massive strides and improvements within the past year including: Missions & Achievements, the Vehicle Armor System, Vehicle Unlock Missions, the Sledgehammer arena and more!

http://www.rocketeergames.com/media/Promo/frostbite_fin.jpg

This month we've made overall improvements with spawn protection, additional vehicle unlock missions, vehicle combat design, and various bug fixes. This is just the first of many exciting updates and features to come.

Join us today and test your mettle on the battlefield!


Check the Patch Notes below for details:

[olist] Improved Spawn Protection
 When spawning from the Base, players will have 30 seconds of invulnerability while inside the spawn bubble.
 Vehicles and Infantry inside the spawn bubble can damage and destroy enemies camping outside the Spawn Zone.
 Free Base vehicles will have unlimited invulnerability until a player enters the vehicle. The Vehicle will then inherit the player's remaining invulnerability timer.
 If the player exits the vehicle while still in the base, the vehicle will lose its Spawn Base invulnerability and will be destroyable once its inherited Spawn Protection runs out.
 Favela's Blue Team Spawn Zone has been adjusted and now covers more area.

 Free New Vehicle Unlocks 
 
 5 Vehicle Unlock missions have been added (4 Tanks & 1 APC)
 Unlock Vehicles are available in the Store for purchase, however purchasing these vehicles will not complete the mission.
 Previous requirements for the Vehicle Unlock Missions have also been adjusted. The "Destroy Transports" requirements for most Steel missions have been changed to "Kill Infantry".
 Level prerequisites for Steel Fist Missions have been lowered by 3 levels.


 Bug Fixes 
 Fixed a health bug that spawned players with much less health than other players or extremely high levels of health in comparison to other players. 
 Removed the ability to sell Unlock weapons for low honors. Once a weapon is unlocked from the tier tree, it will remain in the account.
 Fixed a bug with the score displaying players with 0 kills and 0 deaths during a match.
 Profile rename bug (can't click name field)has been fixed.
 Fixed an issue where the players would not be able to buy quantities of consumables or chests in between matches.
 Fixed an issue that prevented some players from joining matches.
 Fixed an issue where some clan names could not be selected for creating a CVC, all clans should be fine now.

[/olist]

notes.title: New Spawn Protection System
notes.content:
Hello Community!

After receiving lots of positive feedback with the implementation of the new Spawn Protection system in Red Crucible Reloaded, RGS has decided to implement this system into Red Crucible Firestorm. This new system was created to help discourage spawn camping from both sides of the base; Allowing soldiers stuck in the base to fire back at the enemy and giving base dwellers only a limited time of invulnerability inside of their base spawn zone rather than unlimited time.

Here is how the new Spawn Protection works:

 All Players while inside their team's Spawn Protection Zones will receive 30 seconds of Spawn Protection. The 30 seconds will carry over to any vehicle you enter while inside the Spawn Protection Zones.
 Free Base Vehicles that have not been entered will stay invulnerable inside the Spawn Protection Zone until they have been entered by a player.
 fend off enemy units camping outside their base.
 If a player stays inside the Spawn Protection Zone for longer than 30 seconds, they will no longer be invulnerable to enemy fire.
 Once a player leaves the Spawn Protection Zone, they will no longer be protected even if they return inside the Spawn Protection Zone.



This system is now up and running in Red Crucible Firestorm!

notes.title: The Hell Bender
notes.content:
[BREAKING NEWS] 

The Hell Raiser Support weapon has lived up to its name; raising hell among players across the battlefield and earning its reputation as arguably the strongest weapon in the game.
With countless requests for the return of the Hell Raiser, RGS has an official announcement to make. Today, the Hell Raiser will officially be retired from Red Crucible and will not be returning to the Red Crucible Store.

For those who have been asking and eagerly awaiting for the Hell Raiser's return, a successor has come in its place: The Hellbender

http://www.rocketeergames.com/media/Promo/HellBenderPromo.jpg

When comparing the Hellbender to the Hell Raiser, you will notice 2 very similar M60 Support Weapons. Despite not having a silencer, the stats between the Hell Raiser and Hellbender are nearly identical. If you've been waiting for the Hell Raiser release, now is your chance for the next best thing!

You can find the Hellbender now available in the Red Crucible Firestorm Store. Feeling Nostalgic? Test your luck and go for the Hellbender P with the Hellbender Warchest.

http://www.rocketeergames.com/media/Promo/HellBenderPPromo.jpg

notes.title: Patches & Updates 8/25/2016
notes.content:
Hey Community, 

Its been a while since we released our last Patches & Updates. 
Here's a list of changes that have been added to Red Crucible Firestorm. As we come closer to completing Unity 5 development, we'll be sure to have more exciting news to share in the next upcoming months. Without further adieu, here's whats been added since the last RCF Patches & Updates.

1. Weapon/Vehicle Adjustments
 Snowball Cannon Capacity increased
 Snowball Cannon Firerate increased
 Snowball Cannon Damage decreased
 Minotaur recoil decreased
 Minotaur magnification slightly increased
 Panzerfaust Capacity increased from 9 to 11


2. Arena Adjustments
 Removed some small objects and obstacles in Frankfurt to reduce the amount of clutter and boost performance.
 Removed invisible colliders from some large bushes in Frankfurt for players to hide inside.


3. Price Changes 
 All Unlock Vehicles have been added to the RCF Store for 250 coins and 25,000 honors.
 Bronze Level Vehicles have had their coin prices dropped from 300 coins to 250 coins.
 Bronze Level Vehicles have had their honor prices dropped from 30,000 honors to 25,000 honors.


4. Bug Fix
 Beast S texture has been fixed
 Fixed a location in Kiev that caused players to suicide while crouching.
 The Duke's damage has been corrected to be a 1 shot to the chest
 Added and adjusted Attachment Icons on some weapons to accurately display the Attachments on the weapons.

notes.title: Patches & Updates 6/21/2016
notes.content:
Check out whats new to Red Crucible Firestorm since our last Patches & Updates announcements. From Vehicle Unlock Missions to Arena fixes and updates, RGS has been working hard to on making improvements to the game.

1. Schedules & Promotions Updates

 Bargain Ballistics have been moved to Fridays on a Bi-Weekly Basis.
 The Prototype Series has been introduced and will be released on Mondays on a Bi-Weekly Basis.
 Prototype Weapons will only be available for a limited time and will only be released twice a year.

2. Vehicle Unlock Missions Introduced

 8 Vehicle Unlock Missions have been introduced to Red Crucible.
 Tanks, APC's, Artillery, Anti Air, Helicopter and Transport Missions are now available for all players to unlock more free Vehicles.
 Missions must be completed using the Vehicles specified in the Mission Description.

3. Red Dawn Update

 The side doors of the Airport have now been opened to increase traffic inside the Airport
 The wall separating the 2 base tunnels and basement now has a door for players to reach the other side of the airport faster.
 Craters by the planes have been removed.

4. Stats and Adjustments

 PT76 Minimum Damage Increased from 300 to 400.
 Panzer Pistol capacity increased.
 Panzer Pistol accuracy increased.
 Pain Killer is now a Platinum Class weapon.
 DP64 capacity increased from 4 to 6.
 DP-28 damage corrected to its proper caliber type.
 Double Dz accuracy slightly increased
 Double Dz reload time slightly decreased.
 M16 reload Animation changed.
 M16 placement adjusted

5. Bug Fixes

 A bug that caused the Lil Slugga to disappear while playing in a match has been fixed.
 Iron Sight Accuracy and alignment for all weapons have been improved.
 Corrected a bug with 2 of the new Vehicle Unlock Missions (Tank and APC) that allowed players to complete the missions with any vehicle.
 Object and Environment collision has been tweaked and improved in Kiev arena.
 Fixed a bug that didn't allow players to join Kiev Territories matches
 Fixed a bug in Red Dawn where players would fall through the floor behind the plane closest to Red Base.

notes.title: Red Dawn Update
notes.content:
Hello Community!
After careful consideration and play testing over this past year, RGS has made some more changes to one of its arenas: Red Dawn

Like in Red Crucible Reloaded, Red Crucible Firestorm will be opening the side doors in Red Dawn. With this change, players should see an increase of traffic to the inside portions of the airport. The wall in the far back portion of the airport (separating the two base tunnels) will also have an opening for players to cut across if the cafe area is far too hectic.

Red Dawn has also received an updated lighting pass, with more consistent lighting all around.
You can now check out these new changes by creating a new Red Dawn Match. Older Red Dawn matches wont see the new updates until they are closed down.

notes.title: Patches & Updates 5/12/2016
notes.content:
Hey Red Crucible Fans!
Here is whats new in Red Crucible Firestorm since the last Patches & Updates. From the new TDM Game Mode to the new Mortar Consumable and Store Updates, get all caught up with your Red Crucible News here.


 1. New Mortar Consumable 

 A new Mortar consumable has been added in the game. 
 This consumable fires up to 12 Anti-Infantry rounds and functions similarly to a minigun however it fires with an arc like an Artillery Vehicle.
 Once placed, the mortar is mounted to the ground and cannot be used by anyone else other than that player.


 2. New Game Mode TDM: Resorces (Vehicle Maps) 

 Vehicle Maps Like A7 Autobahn, Sledgehammer and Sand Storm now support the "Infantry Only" game mode.
 Just like TDM Armored, The game is won by the team that hits the kill limit first or has the most points after the timer has ended.
 Only Transport Vehicles are allowed to be spawned in TDM Resorces for vehicle maps.
 No Tanks, Helicopters, Artillery, Anti Air or APCs will be allowed to be spawned in this game mode.


 3. Vehicles & Weapons Updates and Adjustments 

 The TOS-1 and AS90 Artillery Vehicles have been removed from the store.
 The Akula SVD scope has been broght in closer to the player's view.
 The MRAP Transport has recieved an additional Mounted Gun for the Driver to use.
 The MRAP Armor has been increased from 800 to 1200 armor.
 The MRAP Transport forward speed has been reduced from 85 to 75.
 Driver gunner's damage has been reduced from 26 to 20
 The FG42 mag count has been increased from 3 to 4.
 MGL capacity has been increased from 1 to 2.
 Panzer Pistol accuracy has been increased.
 Panzer Pistol reload speed increased.
 Panzer Pistol Recoil decreased.


 4. Store and Schedule Updates 

 Bargain Ballistics and the Gun Runner Series will be rotated on a Bi-Weekly Basis at the beginning of every week (Monday/Tuesday)
 New Weapons, Vehicles and Chests will be released in the middle of the week (Wednesday/Thursday)
 New Weapons will be released with corresponding Warchests.
 Prices of the PMC Spartan, PMC Wolverine, Insurgent Guerrilla and Insurgent Renegade have been lowered to 500 coins 50,000 honors
 The USSR Bundle has returned to the Red Crucible Firestorm Store
 Select Character Bundles have been removed from the store.


 5. Bug Fixes 

 Fixed a vehicle spawning bug in Sandstorm that would prevent players from spawning Artillery, Transports and Anti Air temporarily.
 The Grach Pistol is now silenced as intended.
 Frankfurt Tree Collision has been tweaked and corrected. Bullets will not be stopped by invisible colliders along tree trunks and branches.
 Badger P now shows the correct skin/camo on all Quality Settings.

notes.title: Patches & Updates 4/11/2016
notes.content:
Apologies for the late Patches and Updates report Steam Players!
We have been hard at work making improvements and adding content these past couple months, however we have the list of new stuff right here for ya. All of these patches and updates were added to Red Crucible Firestorm on 4/11/2016. We will be sure to keep you updated on the next upcoming Patches and Updates news.

 1.Additions and Updates 
• All rockets, air strikes, artillery strikes, lock-on, and regular rockets now move faster.
• A7 Autobahn now has the Frontlines Game Mode
• Camera shake while zoomed in on a Sniper Scope has been reduced.
• Tracer Color has been adjusted.
• The Talon Sniper now does its full damage to Vehicles as it once did before in Red Crucible 2. 40 Base Damage & 80 Damage in the Vehicle Critical Zone

 2.New Spawn Protection 
• Players in the spawn cannot kill enemies while inside the spawn. This was introduced to reduce camping inside the spawn to get easy enemy kills
• Players cannot destroy Team spawnable vehicles that are inside the spawn
• Vehicles can be destroyed inside the base Spawn protection if a driver is inside

 3. New Store Rotation 
• Weapons and Warchests in the Store will now be rotated on a weekly basis instead of a monthly basis like before.

 4. Weapon/Vehicle Stat Updates 
• Tiger Saw's Range has been increased

 5.Bug 
• Fixed a bug that players would see a blue screen when they would zoom in the MLRS and M2A1 Passenger Machine Guns
• Fixed a bug where missions and achievements would not update progress properly.
• Fixed a bug that caused the air strikes to sometimes fire upwards rather than from the sky.
• Fixed a bug where players were constantly protected by spawn protection.
• Fixed a bug that reduced the Splash Damage Size of the MGL and Panzer Pistol grenades. The size has been corrected.
• Corrected an issue with the displayed Damage and actual damage being output.
• Fixed a bug where the UH-1N's side turrets could not be moved./
• Fixed a bug where Co-pilot fire would heal enemies instead of damage enemies
• Fixed a bug where the Katana would get closer to the player's camera every time they swing

notes.title: Weapon Pricing Update
notes.content:

The honor sell back prices will also be reduced along with the sale prices. This change will be set on all store Bronze/Silver weapons starting today and will gradually effect all Bronze/Silver weapons in the game overtime.

notes.title: Patches, Updates and More!
notes.content:
http://www.rocketeergames.com/media/Promo/frostbite_fin.jpg
New Map: Sledgehammer
A lot of new stuff has been introduced to Red Crucible Firestorm since our last update. Lots of fun stuff including a New Map, a New Game Mode, various Vehicle Updates and more!
You can check out the full list here.


Patches & Updates 2/2/2015

1. General Performance Improvements

 Blood and Gore effects have been optimized and reduced.
 Overall in-game visuals and effects have been optimized.
 Previous explosion particles have been replaced with a more optimized version. 


2. New Arena: Sledgehammer

 A large and snowy map designed with vehicle combat in mind. 
 Sledgehammer is currently the largest arena in Red Crucible Firestorm.


3. New Game Mode: Frontlines

 Capture all control points in succession to win. If the timer ends, the team with the highest score wins.
 Larger Control Points to allow both Vehicle and Infantry cover.
 Takes longer to capture Control Points than Territories 


4. Improved Mission Sorting System

 Players can now see all available missions listed when set on "All" 
 Achievements with multiple parts have been segmented into multiple achievements rather than one. 
 Additional Missions have been added.
 Missions now have level requirements to help organize mission progression and reduce clutter. 


5. UI & Settings Adjustments 

 "Bloodlust" option has been added to the Settings Menu to turn on/off Gore effects.
 Number of players in a capture zone (both teammates and Enemies) are now displayed while capturing an objective.
 All display maps (U Key) have been resized and aligned properly 
 Hitting vehicles with coaxial fire or infantry rounds will not display a hit marker unless hit in critical zones.
 Custom Icons for Achievements have been added.
 Health Bars are now visually displayed over Vehicles


6. New Camera Effects

 Camera shake has been implemented for Explosions, Reloads and some Weapon Fire.
 A New death camera has been implemented to show the enemy who killed you for a short period of time.
 Sniper Class will not be shown by the New Death Camera.


7. Vehicle Adjustments & Improvements

 Base Spawned APC's now have an improved firerate on their main cannons
 New damage values have been implemented for vehicle damage zones.
 All vehicles and helicopters now have detailed damage zones
 Damage is now displayed with color coded numbers to help players see their damage output on enemy vehicles and helicopters.
 Health Bars are now visually displayed over Vehicles to show damage progress.
 Vehicle damage is now rewarded instead of Vehicle kills. (Vehicle Score)
 Multiple players can now earn rewards for the damage they inflicted on enemy vehicles. (Vehicle Score)


8. Weapon Adjustments & Improvements

 Damage done to vehicles by coaxial fire and infantry rounds will do minimal damage unless hit in the vehicle's critical zones.
 Shamrock Revolver's Accuracy increased 
 Shamrock Revolver's firerate increased 
 Shamrock Revolver's recoil decreased
 Death Adder Magnification Increased
 Death Adder Recoil Decreased
 Death Adder Reload Time Increased


9. Bugs

 Fixed Loading screen connection issue for Steam Users.
 Fixed an issue where players would sometimes receive negative health instead of die after being shot.
 Fixed a bug that created multiple hill zones on Conquer when first joining a match.  
 Fixed a bug where players were able to use a consumable to teleport between walls.
 Corrected an issue with the Join Button not appearing for Search & Destroy Survivor Matches
 Corrected an issue that caused the Hellraiser and M1919 Calibers to use Vehicle Caliber (Armor Piercing) rounds instead of Infantry Caliber rounds. This would result in 1 hit kills instead of 2 hit kills as intended.
 Corrected an issue where some gears did not appear on the character

notes.title: Patches & Updates 12/30/2015
notes.content:
Hello Community, 
Much has changed since our last update including the New Achievements and Stats System, a newly designed A7 Autobahn, the addition of Blood and Gore, and much more!

Here is whats new and updated since the last update in Red Crucible Firestorm. 

 1. Achievements & Stat Recording 

 The new Achievement System has been introduced.
 Achievements, Missions, and badges are now implemented and now reward players for completing tasks.
 Stats are now recorded and shown in the Player's Profile. This can be found in Social> Profile> My Profile

 2. Blood & Gore implemented 

 A Blood & Gore feature has been introduced to Red Crucible.
 Blood splatter now temporarily stains walls & floors
 Headshots will remove heads and spew fountains
 Explosive Kills will tear apart the Infantry 

 3. Newly Designed A7 Autobahn 

 Some design adjustments have been made to help improve gameplay experience and overall performance.
 Removed clutter and unnecessary obstacles in the arena
 Some objects are now destructible including some fences and light posts

 4. New UI Layout 

• The Score Board and After Game Summary have been a new UI Layout.
• Achievements & Missions Layout/selection

 5. Adjustments & Corrections 

 The Dual Uzi's Ammo Clip Capacity has been increased from 30 to 40 rounds
 Javelin's blast radius has been corrected to Demolition blast radius
 The Miniguns (Support Weapon) Ammo Clip capacity has been increased from 100 to 200 rounds
 Master Blaster Ammo Capacity has been increased from 10 to 12 rounds
 Master Blaster's reload speed has been slightly increased 
 Master Blaster's Fire Rate increased from 1 to 2 rounds per second
 Saiga Ammo Capacity has been increased from 8 to 10 rounds
 The AH64's armor has been increased from 800 to 1200
 The AH64 fires guided rockets instead 4 basic rockets
 Reload Time shortened for AH64's guided rockets
 UAZ Vehicle turret fire rate has been corrected from 1 round per second to 10 rounds per second.
 Mac App users AN94 has been updated to have Burst Fire feature as intended.
 The Nakita's round capacity has been increased from 40 round to 50 rounds
 The Nakita's Clip capacity has been decreased from 3 to 2.
 Warhammer Damage Zones have been updated to be more detailed.
 Reduced amount of rockets for Z11 and Kiowa rockets from 32 to 8

 6. Territories Mode Adjustments 

 Capturing a capture point will give your team a temporary 10 point boost so long as your team hold the capture point.
If the capture point is taken away from your team, then those 10 points will be removed from your team's overall score and given to the opposing team.
This change has been added to help give more incentive to capture and hold checkpoints in territories. Players will still earn Honors for capturing Control points. 

 7. Match Summary Rewards 

 Losing Teams will only earn a fraction of their Match Summary Rewards. This has been added to put more importance and focus on capturing objectives, winning matches
and increasing teamwork. 
 Losing penalty has been adjusted from 30%-40% reward reduction to 20%-25% reward reduction per loss.

 8. Bug Fixes 

 Vehicle Armor Display now appears properly while at a spawn zone.
 Corrected a Clan Display issue that some players were not able to see all their Clan mates in the Clan Member List. 
 Corrected an issue that caused occasional lag spikes when players would enter a match.
 Corrected an issue on Boosts not showing correct expiration and/or causing errors preventing their purchase.
 Moved Center of gravity of the UAZ to help prevent the vehicle from flipping.
 Headshot Reward display has been corrected. Players now get 3 xp/hp per headshot
 Shotgun Accuracy Stat recording Bug fixed.
 Vehicle Accuracy Stat recording Bug fixed.

notes.title: New Vehicle Update Has Arrived
notes.content:
New Vehicle Update

The New Vehicle Update has finally come to Red Crucible Firestorm!
There are now free vehicles spawned and available for each team when players play in vehicle maps like A7 Autobahn and Sandstorm. The Vehicles also now have a new HUD display to show your vehicle's health, weapons, and ammo. 

As a special thanks to our Veteran Players, you all now have your own spawnable vehicles that you can spawn at any time from the vehicle spawners. These are the Vehicles you have been playing with and testing since the release of Red Crucible Firestorm. New players can still get these vehicles in the Red Crucible Store.

 Here are the Patches and Updates of 9/17/2015 

 1. New Vehicles
•  New Vehicles are being introduced to Red Crucible Firestorm including the Anti Air and Artillery Class
•  Free Vehicles automatically  appear on the map and purchased vehicles will be spawnable at vehicle spawn points
•  Players cant share spawned vehicles, with the exception of the gunner seats. 

 2. New Vehicle HUD 
•  A New Vehicle HUD has been implemented for Vehicles.
•  A compass

 3. Key Bindings Option 
•  Players can now change their Key Bindings in the options menu.
•  Removed Standalone Launcher

 4. Match Completion Summery 
•  More specifics will be provided on the Match Completion Summary, including Honors,Experience and rewards earned

 5. Message Removal Checkboxes 
•  Delete Messages with ease by clicking the [x] by your messages

 6. Improved Security Features 
•  More security patches have been released to help improve overall community and gameplay experience

notes.title: Whats Coming to Red Crucible
notes.content:
Patches & Updates 8/14/2015 

Its been pretty quiet since we've shared our last update. The studio has been hard at work creating new features and updates for Red Crucible. There have been a few updates since the last Patches & Updates from 7/16/2015:

 1. Sniper Rifle Patches 
• Fixed an issue were Bolt Action Sniper Rifles would not play firing sounds in First person.
• Corrected an issue where Gold/Platinum Sniper scopes started out at max zoom.
• Fixed Beast B constant zooming bug

 2. Weapon Design Updates 
• The Classic M82 Predator got a new Model and Texture.
• All MGLs have been given the scope feature.

 3. Vehicle Updates 
• Vehicles now have a 3rd Person reticle to help players aim at their targets in 3rd person.
• The Vehicle's turret direction is now displayed on the minimap.

 4. Performance Improvements 
• Overall performance tweaks implemented to help increase performance for lower performing computers.

 Whats Coming to Red Crucible 

As stated above, we still have more features coming that the studio has be hard at work on.
Not much can be announced as of yet but here is a few hints on what we have been working on and what is soon to come:

1. More Vehicles
2. New Vehicle HUD
3. New Display Sizing Option
4. Message Check Box System
5. Improved Security Features
6. Something new to Red Crucible

On that note, we hope you have been enjoying Red Crucible Firestorm.
See you in game!

notes.title: Patches & Updates 7/16/2015
notes.content:

1. Restricted Vehicle UI Glitch (Fixed) 
• Vehicles would appear as unavailable when spawning from the vehicle spawn due to deployable consumables being counted against the vehicle limit.	

2. Vehicle Movement Adjustments 
• Adjustments to handling and maneuverability of all vehicles. The turrets and barrels are now fixed towards the target when driving.

3. Shamrock Low Quality Bug 
•Fixed an issue with the Shamrock Secondary Weapon not loading on Low Quality Settings.

4. Promotion Page Update
• Added an extra section to the Promotion Page
• The Berkut is now available in the store for 1 coin and 1 honor

5. New Legendary Chests 
• A new chest that is available for both Coins and Honors has been released. The chests are cheaper and easier to get, but are more challenging to win the Platinum Level weapon.

notes.title: Patches & Updates 7/9/2015
notes.content:
Updates 7/9/2015

 1. Kiev Bug Fix: 
• Removed Collision from along the back end of the ship that allowed players to access otherwise inaccessible parts in the map.

2. Inventory Limit Fix:
• Corrected a bug that hid inventory items from players with large amounts of Inventory items. (Exceeding Inventory Memory Limit) Memory Limit has been extended. 

3. Vote Kick Feature:
• A Public Vote Kick Feature has been added to the game. Players will need a 70% approval in order to successfully kick a troublesome player from a match. (Approval rate may be tweaked in the future)

4. Private and Clan vs Clan Matches:
• As requested and awaited by many fans, Private Matches and Clan vs Clan Matches have returned. Private matches can only be accessed by friends, and friends of friends already in the match. Clan vs Clan will be similar to Clan vs All, however it can only be accessed by the 2 Clans in the match. 


5. Re Arranged Menu UI:
• Re-arranged categories in the Character Menu. The Unlock Tab has been moved forward and the Store Tab has been moved to the rear.

notes.title: State of the Game
notes.content:
State of the Game

It has been an exciting and eventful time for Red Crucible Firestorm since its release. The game has vastly grown since its release in April with many updates, patches and features included in the game.  We would like to thank you all for growing with us and Red Crucible Firestorm as we continue to make improvements in the game.

 Coming Soon...

We still have much much more to come for Red Crucible Firestorm including new arenas, game modes, weapons, bundles and vehicles. However, these are some of the things players can expect to see coming soon to the game:

1. Vote to Kick Feature
2. Visual Design Update
3. Camera Effects

 Updates this Past Month 

 6/17/2015 

1.New Game Mode
• The Territories Game Mode has been added to Infantry Maps


 6/12/2015 

1. Free Starter Bundles
• The US Soldier and Russian Soldier

2. Gun Sound Update
• All Tier Class Weapons have had their firing sounds updated. (Assault, Support, Sniper, Secondary and Demolitions)

 5/29/2015 

1. Steam Early Access
• Red Crucible Firestorm launched on Steam Early Access

 5/20/2015 

1. Class Tiers available for Honors
• Players can now purchase all Tier class weapons for honor points, including T9 to T12

2. Consumables Available for Honors
• All consumables are available for honors and have a more affordable honor price. This change has been made to increase consumable use in Red Crucible Firestorm

3. Vehicle & Helicopter Spawn Patch
• Corrected issue where vehicles and helicopters would spawn on top of each other. 
• Vehicles and helicopters now move forward when spawned from the Vehicle Spawner.

4. Vehicle Flip Patch
• A patch has been released to help reduce the amount of Vehicle flipping upside down.

5. Sniper Zoom Feature
• Gold rank Sniper rifles now have a zoom feature.
•Players can now use the mouse wheel while looking down the scope to zoom in and out.

6. Red Dawn Design Test
• The tunnels have been reopened and a wall placed in between the stair ways inside the airport to test game flow.

7. Kiev Spawn Point Update.
• The spawn wall in blue base has been reduced on the sides of the ship to prevent Blue team snipers from exploiting the spawn protection.

8. Tracer Rounds
• The color of the Tracer rounds have been changed to red.


 5/13/2015 

1. Mac App Release
• Red Crucible Firestorm has officially approved and released in the Mac App Store. Mac Users can now download the game from the Mac App Store.

2. Kiev Additions & Adjustments
•Adjusted Base Spawn Protection Zones
•Added Walls in front of Blue Base Spawn

3. Red Dawn Design Changes
• Sealed off tunnel passage ways for game flow testing
• Additional Spawn points

4. Sniper Class Adjustments
• Increased Accuracy of Sniper rifles when looking down the sights
• Increased zoom for all sniper rifles

5. Stinger View Adjustments
• The Stinger has been moved farther to the right of the player's screen for a better view of the playing field.
